hotels.title: Fiji Romantic Adults-Only Luxury on Taveuni Island with All-Inclusive Dining & Return Airport Transfers
hotels.description: Perched on the clifftops high above sparkling blue seas on the 'Garden Island of Fiji' lies Taveuni Island Resort & Spa, a boutique resort offering pure laidback luxury. Twelve private, stand-alone villas are tucked into lush tropical gardens, each opening to uninterrupted ocean views and designed with seclusion in mind, making it easy to lose track of time entirely. A dazzling infinity pool anchors the heart of the resort, where a relaxed dining space and tropical bar spill out onto the grounds, the natural setting for long lunches, sunset drinks and the sort of unhurried evenings that only a place this intimate can deliver. Its onsite organic farm supplies the kitchen with fresh fruits, vegetables, herbs and spices that are transformed into mouth-watering dishes at the resort's onsite restaurant. Taveuni is renowned for its untouched rainforests, spectacular waterfalls and world-class diving - this is your chance to discover it all.
